next_question.text: Your site says you sell to platform engineering teams. Who signs off on the spend?
next_question.why: You named the trigger; the budget holder is the last gap before the document can be used for targeting.
next_question.example_answer: The Head of Platform at 50+ engineers; below that, the CTO.

report.title: ICP interview: question 2
report.summary: Your site says you sell to platform engineering teams. Who signs off on the spend? Already known: Series A to C SaaS with a platform team, postmortems written by hand, and a customer-noticed outage as the trigger.

items.text: Segment: B2B SaaS companies at Series A to Series C with a platform engineering team.
items.label: inferred

items.text: Pain: engineers lose hours writing incident postmortems by hand.
items.label: inferred

items.text: Nice-to-have: already uses PagerDuty or Datadog (the integrations the pricing page lists).
items.label: inferred

items.text: Trigger: an outage customers notice, after which the CTO asks for better postmortems.
items.label: validated

items.label: vague

items.label: vague
